paragraphs: Mentioned in Chagigah 14a; the reading in the Ein Yaakov is Rav Acha bar Yaakov. The statement is likewise cited in Yalkut Isaiah, remez 63.[^1]

notes.text: ע״י is contextually Ein Yaakov when citing a reading, not a fresh edition check. יד. gives Chagigah 14a; סג׳ gives remez 63 with the terminal mark not an additional numeral. Papa and the reported Acha bar Yaakov reading both have explicit Rav and remain different names without an identity merger. The statement’s likewise citation to Yalkut Isaiah is Hyman’s report.
